info.name: Atelier Health - Hospital Management System
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Atelier Health HMS backend. 21 microservices behind an API Gateway.

## Setup
1. Register a user via Auth > Register
2. Login via Auth > Login — the token is auto-saved
3. Use other endpoints as needed

## Variables
- `baseUrl`: API Gateway URL (default: http://localhost:4000)
- `token`: JWT token (auto-set on login)
- `refreshToken`: Refresh token (auto-set on login)
